name: Sarpadia
description: Region of Dominaria where the siblings grew up.

description_citations.text: "Tymolin Loneglade". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Icatia falls, the last of the Sarpadian empires.
timeline.quote: Valiant Icatia was the last of the Sarpadian empires to fall.

citation.text: Icatian Infantry (Fallen Empires, 1994), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: After the Brothers' War the Ice Age approaches Sarpadia, bringing dwindling resources and fighting among allies.
timeline.quote: The changing climate results in dwindling resources and fighting amongst allies for survival.

citation.text: "Fallen Empires", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sarpadia is plunged into chaos; the Ebon Hand is torn apart by a Thrull Rebellion and only thrulls and thallids remain.
timeline.quote: The Ebon Hand would be torn apart inside out by a Thrull Rebellion.

citation.work: Fallen Empires on the World of Magic: The Gathering
citation.text: "Fallen Empires on the World of Magic: The Gathering", section "Aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Thelon creates the thallids by infusing fungus with green mana and borrowed dark rites.
timeline.quote: Thelon created the thallids by infusing natural fungus with green mana

citation.text: "Fungus", section "Thallids". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The thallids rebel against their creators and destroy their empire entirely.
timeline.quote: Eventually, they would rebel against their creators destroying their empire entirely.

citation.text: "Fungus", section "Thallids". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Orggs are used in the war against Icatia by the goblin-orc alliance on Sarpadia around AR 170.
timeline.quote: On Sarpadia , Orggs were used in the war against Icatia by the goblin -orc alliance around AR 170.

citation.text: "Orgg", section "Lore". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Reod Dai kills one of the Ironclaw Orcs.
timeline.quote: Reod Dai killed one of them.

citation.text: "Orgg", section "Lore". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After Urza activates the Golgothian Sylex the climate cools, crops fail, and strife breaks out between former allies; homarids encroach on merfolk waters.
timeline.quote: After Urza activated the Golgothian Sylex , the climate of the entire world rapidly cooled.

citation.text: "Sarpadia", section "Climate Change". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The dwarven kingdom falls to a chaos-driven army of orcs and goblins, followed by the Ebon Hand falling to the thrulls and the elves to the thallids.
timeline.quote: starting with the fall of the dwarven kingdom to a chaos-driven army of orcs and goblins

citation.text: "Sarpadia", section "Fall of the Empires". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Icatia, weakened by the Farrelite Cult, finally falls to orcs, goblins, thrulls and thallids aided by Tevesh Szat, and Vodalia is conquered by homarids.
timeline.quote: The last empire to fall was Icatia

citation.text: "Sarpadia", section "Fall of the Empires". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The thrulls destroy the goblins and the last of the orcs and keep evolving, content with their isolation.
timeline.quote: the goblins were destroyed by the thrulls

citation.text: "Sarpadia", section "Thrull Rebellion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tev and Tymolin are caught up in the Brothers' War with disastrous results, leaving Tev guilt-ridden and exiled from society in Sarpadia.
timeline.quote: Tev was left guilt-ridden, and eventually the two returned to Sarpadia where Tev chose to exile himself from society.

citation.text: "Tevesh Szat", section "Youth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kaylen falls in battle when an orc stabs him from behind during an attack on the Dwarven empire.
timeline.quote: Kaylen fell in battle when he was stabbed from behind by an orc.

citation.text: "Tevesh Szat", section "Sarpadia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tev refuses Tymolin's plea to intervene against the forces of chaos.
timeline.quote: Tev continued his lack of intrusion, refusing to either stop the orcs and goblins or help the dwarves.

citation.text: "Tevesh Szat", section "Sarpadia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tymolin is captured by Vaylesh and the Ebon Hand and stabbed to death by Farrel.
timeline.quote: which backfired when Farrel stabbed Tymolin to death.

citation.text: "Tevesh Szat", section "Transformation to Tevesh Szat". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sensing his sister's death, Tev fully transforms into a serpentine dragon form and incinerates the Ebon Hand encampment, killing Sianna, Farrel and Vaylesh.
timeline.quote: Tev incinerated everyone present, including Sianna, Oliver Farrel, and Vaylesh.

citation.text: "Tevesh Szat", section "Transformation to Tevesh Szat". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tev renames himself Tevesh Szat and summons the orc-goblin army onto Montford with a Planar Gate, then begins destroying the empires of Sarpadia.
timeline.quote: His first action was to use a Planar Gate to summon the orc–goblin army onto Montford .

citation.text: "Tevesh Szat", section "Fall of Sarpadia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Endrek Sahr creates the first thrulls on Sarpadia as slaves for the Order of the Ebon Hand.
timeline.quote: the thrulls were first created by Endrek Sahr as slaves for the Order of the Ebon Hand

citation.text: "Thrull", section "Sarpadian Thrulls". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Reod Dai convinces thrulls to turn on their masters; they annihilate the Order and wipe out all non-thrull life in Sarpadia except the thallids; Jherana Rure is killed by thrull assassins.
timeline.quote: annihilating the Order and, save for the thallids , eventually wiping out all non-thrull life in Sarpadia.

citation.text: "Thrull", section "Sarpadian Thrulls". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Order orders Sahr's execution over his derelor; Vaylesh's derelor is struck down by Tevesh Szat's Fireball.
timeline.quote: This eventually led to an order for Sahr's execution.

citation.text: "Thrull", section "Sarpadian Thrulls". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The thrulls repel the Phyrexian invaders without planeswalkers and continue to rule Sarpadia.
timeline.quote: the thrulls became so powerful that they repelled the Phyrexian invaders without the aid of planeswalkers .

citation.text: "Thrull", section "Sarpadian Thrulls". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Thrulls served faithfully until the Rebellion.
timeline.quote: "Until the Rebellion, thrulls served their masters faithfully—even at the cost of their own lives."

citation.text: Thrull Retainer (Fifth Edition, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ivra Jursdotter recalls an ogre turning on its commander.
timeline.quote: "We were holding our own—until the ogre guiding us suddenly grinned and turned on our commander."

citation.text: Ghazbán Ogre (Fifth Edition, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: During the Phyrexian Invasion, Phyrexians are rumored to be defeated by thrulls on Sarpadia.
timeline.quote: it was rumored that the metal demons of Phyrexia met insurmountable resistance from the thrulls in Sarpadia

citation.text: "Sarpadia", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Inspired by Tourach, Sahr creates living thrulls from dead flesh.
timeline.quote: to create not undead but living creatures from dead flesh

citation.text: "Endrek Sahr", section "Creating the thrulls". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sahr creates armor thrulls and thrull wizards.
timeline.quote: creating the thrull wizard to assist in ceremonies

citation.text: "Endrek Sahr", section "Experimentation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Ebon Hand captures a Yawgmoth Priest, who refuses Sahr's questioning and predicts his punishment in Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: the Yawgmoth Priest refused to give any information

citation.text: "Endrek Sahr", section "The interrogation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sahr creates the derelor; the drain on black mana leads to his execution.
timeline.quote: This failure prompted Sahr's execution.

citation.text: "Endrek Sahr", section "Execution". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Just before execution Sahr is pulled thousands of years forward, sees Sarpadia's ruin, and returns with the Great Mending.
timeline.quote: Pulled thousands of years forward just before his execution

citation.text: "Endrek Sahr", section "Revival". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The elves hire Reod Dai to pit orcs and humans against each other; he unites goblin and orc tribes into one horde.
timeline.quote: the elves hired Reod Dai to pit the two against each other

citation.text: "Fall of the Sarpadian Empires", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Reod Dai's magic gives thallids sentience and he incites the thrull rebellion against the Ebon Hand.
timeline.quote: Reod Dai then incited a rebellion among the thrulls against their Ebon Hand masters.

citation.text: "Fall of the Sarpadian Empires", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tymolin Loneglade is murdered in a ritual sacrifice by Oliver Farrel.
timeline.quote: Tymolin Loneglade was murdered by the zealot Oliver Farrel

citation.text: "Fall of the Sarpadian Empires", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tev Loneglade goes insane, becomes Tevesh Szat and urges goblins and orcs to attack Icatia.
timeline.quote: went insane, assuming the identity of Tevesh Szat

citation.text: "Fall of the Sarpadian Empires", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The thrull rebellion destroys the Ebon Hand, thallids overrun Havenwood, and Icatia is conquered.
timeline.quote: the thrull rebellion destroyed the Ebon Hand

citation.text: "Fall of the Sarpadian Empires", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Surviving dwarves take refuge in an abandoned mine under Captain Sarya Haasendel after General Danhelm is slain.
timeline.quote: With the dwarven leader General Danhelm slain, the surviving dwarves took refuge in a nearby abandoned mine under the leadership of Captain Sarya Haasendel .

citation.text: "Gurn Keep", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oliver breaks from the priesthood, finding the Order too lenient with the Ebon Hand, and gathers followers who become the Farrelites.
timeline.quote: Oliver broke away from the priesthood because he found the Order too lenient

citation.text: "Oliver Farrel", section "Formation of the Farrelites". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Endrek Sahr creates thrulls to serve as slaves and ritual sacrifices.
timeline.quote: created Thrulls to serve them as slaves and ritual sacrifices

citation.text: "Order of the Ebon Hand", section "Creation of the thrulls". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Thrulls breed rapidly and overwhelm the Order; Sahr is ordered executed but a time rift pulls him into the future.
timeline.quote: A time rift seemed to be the only reprieve for Sahr, as he was pulled into the future

citation.text: "Order of the Ebon Hand", section "Creation of the thrulls". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vaylesh captures Tymolin Loneglade and lures Oliver Farrel to combat to draw the Farrelites into the open.
timeline.quote: Vaylesh , a priestess of the Order of the Ebon Hand, captured Tymolin Loneglade

citation.text: "Order of the Ebon Hand", section "Encounter with the Farrelites". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Farrel kills Tym; Tev Loneglade kills all the troops with a Fireball and transforms into Tevesh Szat.
timeline.quote: When Farrel killed Tym, the planeswalker Tev Loneglade killed all the troops present with a massive Fireball .

citation.text: "Order of the Ebon Hand", section "Encounter with the Farrelites". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The thrull wizards spark the Thrull Rebellion; Jherana Rure leads resistance until Necrites kill her.
timeline.quote: Necrites eventually killed Rure and ended the resistance in a single blow.

citation.text: "Order of the Ebon Hand", section "Thrull Rebellion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Early Sarpadian saprolings spread by feeding off deaths from the thallid rebellion against the elves.
timeline.quote: spread rapidly by feeding off of the deaths resulting from the thallid rebellion against the elves

citation.text: "Saproling", section "Sarpadia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Thelon creates thallids by infusing fungus with green mana.
timeline.quote: infused the fungus with green mana to create a living creature that produced saprolings

citation.text: "Thallid", section "Sarpadia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Thallids gain sentience and the elves split over destroying or aiding them.
timeline.quote: The elves would be split into two factions

citation.text: "Thallid", section "Sarpadia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The elves are overrun by their creations.
timeline.quote: would eventually be overrun by their creations

citation.text: "Thallid", section "Sarpadia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Thallids help orcs, goblins and thrulls destroy Icatia.
timeline.quote: Thallids would assist the orcs , goblins , and thrulls in destroying Icatia

citation.text: "Thallid", section "Sarpadia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tev ignites his spark and enchants Tymolin with eternal youth.
timeline.quote: he ignited his Planeswalker spark and enchanted Tymolin with eternal youth

citation.text: "Tymolin Loneglade", section "Early life". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: An Orc-Goblin army besieges the Dwarven kingdom; Kaylen falls and Tymolin is banished.
timeline.quote: Kaylen would fall in battle to an Orc

citation.text: "Tymolin Loneglade", section "Conflict". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oliver Farrel stabs Tymolin to death after she refuses him.
timeline.quote: was stabbed to death by Farrel

citation.text: "Tymolin Loneglade", section "Death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tev transforms into Tevesh Szat and slays all present with a Fireball.
timeline.quote: he transformed into Tevesh Szat

citation.text: "Tymolin Loneglade", section "Death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
